title: Import with the host's own basis refuses as divergent when the incoming folder only holds that same own export
outcome: Import with the host's own basis refuses as divergent when the incoming folder only holds that same own export
acceptance: Importing a data folder whose content equals the host's own basis export (no foreign change) into a store that has changed since that export succeeds: local changes win, nothing is reported as a conflict, and the folder is recorded as imported
task_sync_divergent_planning is reported only when the incoming folder changes a task relative to the basis and the local store also changed that task
A store whose own export was written by an older build can rejoin its data branch with one documented command, without a full rebuild
